name: autonomous-pr-lifecycle
description: Reusable GitHub-native pull request validation and repair lifecycle

scripts.test: npm run test:framework && npm run test:apps --
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:framework && npm run test:ci:apps --
scripts.lint:framework: eslint tests/framework vitest.config.js && prettier --check tests/framework package.json vitest.config.js .eslintrc.json .prettierrc
scripts.lint: npm run lint:framework && npm run lint:apps --
